findings.quote: use the City-required form, and file a copy with the City Clerk within 10 calendar days. A missed precondition can invalidate the notice.

findings.quote: Just cause applies from day one of an Emeryville tenancy, not after 12 months

findings.fix: Use 'covered tenancies' consistently and link a brief exemption caveat to the parent guide. Say AB 1482 'generally' begins after 12 months and point to the guide's added-tenant qualification. Source: Emeryville §5-40.02(b) and Civil Code §1946.2.
